topic: MCP vs Skill vs Command vs Hook Decision Tree

claims.claim: Claude Code 2026 ma 4 extension types: MCP Server, Skill, Slash Command, Hook.
MCP Server - model-controlled, LLM decyduje o triggeru, dla external tool/API/data access.
Skill - auto-invoke na keywords/context match, zmienia JAK Claude pracuje (workflow/domain knowledge).
Slash Command - user-controlled explicit trigger `/name [args]`, prompt shortcut.
Hook - event-triggered (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop), automatic shell commands, zero LLM decision.
Decision tree: external system -> MCP; workflow/mind-model -> Skill; reusable shortcut -> Command; automation on event -> Hook.
Kluczowa roznica Skill vs Command: Skill auto-invoke na context match; Command = explicit user trigger.
Token cost MCP: kazdy server ~8-15k tokens tool definitions upfront, doklada do KAZDEGO API call.
Token cost Skill: YAML header + description (<500 tokens) upfront, body on-demand gdy wybrane.
Token cost Command: zero do invocation (lazy load z ~/.claude/commands/*.md).
Token cost Hook: zero (shell commands transparent, nie trafiaja do LLM).
Overlap MCP+Skill pattern: MCP jako executor (Slack send_message), Skill jako mind-model (style guide).
Overlap MCP vs Bash: Bash tanszy tokens-wise (brak tool definitions overhead), MCP better dla structured responses. Rzadkie use -> Bash. Ciezkie use -> MCP.
Empiryczne koszty: MCP-heavy (5 servers) ~60k tokens upfront, Skill approach ~2k tokens, Hybrid (2 MCP + Skill) ~20k tokens.
Tool Search Tool redukcja: z 51k tokens -> 8.5k (46.9% redukcja dla tool defs).
Typowa topologia team-user 2026: 3 MCPs + 5-10 Skills + 10-20 Commands + 3-5 Hooks.
Power-user pattern: personal MCP per projekt z domain context (shop schema, team rules). Koszt ~5-10k tokens.
MCP jako config vector (Skill better alternative) - 90% cases Skill wystarczy; MCP tylko dla live, external, dynamic data.
Plugins (nowosc 2026) - wrapper dla 1+ extensions (MCP + Skill + Command + Hook) jako distributable package (/plugin install).
Skill format: markdown z YAML frontmatter (name, description, auto-trigger), optional files/ subfolder, body jako Anthropic-style instruction.
Command format: markdown z frontmatter (argument-hint, description) i prompt body z $ARGUMENTS substitution.
Hook format w settings.json: hooks.<event>[].matcher + hooks.<event>[].hooks[].command.
